# Task P8-10: Settings → General — the API key and the login account

**Phase:** 8 · **Depends on:** none · **Delegate:** sonnet subagent · **Estimated size:** S

## Goal
A new user installing from the docs alone must be able to (a) find the API key to give Prowlarr, autobrr, Homepage or Unpackerr, and (b) set the username and password of the Forms login — today neither is possible in the UI (P8-08a found it: the API key is only in `/config/config.yml`, the login account only through `PUT /api/v1/auth/user`). This task adds a **General** section to Settings, first in its list, with those two cards and a read-only summary of how the instance is reached.

## Deliverables
- `frontend/src/pages/settings/GeneralSettingsPage.tsx` (+ `GeneralSettingsPage.test.tsx`), wired into `frontend/src/pages/SettingsPage.tsx` as the first section `general` (label "General"; `settings` with no section should open it — check how the section list and the default work there and keep the other sections' URLs unchanged).
- **Security card:**
  - *API key:* shown masked (`••••••••` + the last 4 characters), a "Show" toggle, and a "Copy" button (Mantine `CopyButton`), from the bootstrap config the app already has (`frontend/src/api/bootstrap.ts`, `AppConfig.apiKey` — read how pages reach it, e.g. a context in `ApiProvider.tsx`/`context.ts`). One line of help: "Give this key to Prowlarr, autobrr, Homepage or Unpackerr. It is set in `/config/config.yml` (`server.api_key`) or `APP__SERVER__API_KEY`." (Check the env name in `ServerOptions`/`EnvironmentOverrides` and the docs site's install page under `website/` if it is on `main`.) No "regenerate" button (the backend has none).
  - *Login:* `GET /api/v1/auth/user` → "Signed in as **name**" or "No login account yet". A form with Username (1–64 characters) and Password + Confirm password (at least 8 characters, must match) and a Save button → `PUT /api/v1/auth/user` (204); show the API's validation messages (problem details with `errors`) under the fields; after saving, the card shows the new username and clears the password fields. Help text: "Wondarr asks for this login when it is reached from outside your network (`server.auth_required: disabledForLocalAddresses`, the default)" — confirm the default and wording in `src/Wondarr.Core/Configuration/ServerOptions.cs` (or wherever `ServerOptions` lives).
- **Instance card (read-only):** version and URL base from the bootstrap config; authentication mode and "required for" from `GET /api/v1/system/status` if it reports them (check `SystemStatusResource` in `src/Wondarr.Api/SystemInfo/`), with "Change these in `/config/config.yml` and restart."
- `frontend/src/api/auth.ts`: `useAuthUser()` and `useSetAuthUser()` (TanStack Query), types from `schema.d.ts` if `AuthUserResource`/`UpdateAuthUserResource` are there, else small local types.
- Tests: the key is masked until "Show"; Copy is present; the login card shows the configured username; a save sends `PUT /api/v1/auth/user` with the body and shows success; a 400 shows the field message; mismatched passwords never send; `/settings` opens General.

## Allowed paths
- `frontend/src/pages/settings/GeneralSettingsPage.tsx`, its test, `frontend/src/pages/SettingsPage.tsx` (and its test if one exists), `frontend/src/api/auth.ts`
(Nothing else; do not edit `schema.d.ts` or anything outside `frontend/`.)

## Context to read first
- `frontend/src/pages/SettingsPage.tsx` and one settings page with a form and tests (`NotificationsSettingsPage.tsx` / `SoulseekSettingsPage.tsx`).
- `frontend/src/api/bootstrap.ts`, `ApiProvider.tsx`, `context.ts`, `client.ts`, `errors.ts`.
- `src/Wondarr.Api/Authentication/AuthUserController.cs`, `src/Wondarr.Api/SystemInfo/`.

## Constraints
- Never log the API key or put it in a URL; render it only when "Show" is on.
- Mantine components only; no new npm dependencies; loading/error states as the other settings pages have them.

## Acceptance criteria
1. `cd frontend && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run format && npm test && npm run build` passes (commit what `format` rewrites).
2. The tests above.
